beliefs: f(x) is noisy everywhere: repeated calls at the same x give different values, including at |x|>=2.6 (spread ~±1 at x=3.0, ~±1 at x=2.5, ~±0.6 at x=1.9, ~±0.9 at x=1.2, ~±0.8 at x=0.7, ~±0.5 at x=1.5) [E6, E7, E9]
The mean of f is approximately -3.6*x^3 for |x|>=2.6, matching f(2.6)≈-60.9, f(3.0)≈-98.1, f(2.5)≈-54.1 and f(128)≈-8181913 [E1, E5, E7, E9]
The mean is nearly odd: mean(-x)≈-mean(x) for |x|>=2.6 [E1]
On the positive side the mean decreases smoothly from about x=1.0 onward: f(1.0)≈1.3, f(1.5)≈-7.2, f(1.9)≈-20.5, f(2.0)≈-25.7, f(2.5)≈-54.1, f(2.6)≈-60.9 [E5, E7, E9]
The mean in |x|<2.6 is roughly symmetric and smooth; a polynomial fit through the observed points gives the mean trend [E2, E3, E4, E5]
The mean near x=0 is about 3.7-4.0 (E8 repeats at 0 give 3.70, 4.99, 2.35, 3.67, mean≈3.68), not the ~3.3 the polynomial gave [E8]
The mean is roughly flat/plateau near x=0 (values at ±0.1..±0.4 all cluster around 3-4), with no sharp bump [E8]
Noise magnitude is roughly ±1-2 around the mean, with the mean near 3-4 at x=0 and decreasing outward [E1, E2, E6, E7, E8, E9]
The exact mean shape inside |x|<2.6 is not pinned down; a smooth polynomial fit gives only approximate values there [E2, E3, E4, E5]?
notes: Reduced the cubic coefficient from -3.9 to -3.6 because E9 shows f(3.0)≈-98 (not -105) and f(2.5)≈-54 (not -55); the noise spreads in E9 are also consistent with the model's ±1-2 noise. The inner polynomial and plateau near 0 are kept as before.
